import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 10

# 1. Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette("viridis", 10)
bars = ax1.barh(breed_counts.index[::-1], breed_counts.values[::-1], color=colors[::-1])
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels
for bar, val in zip(bars, breed_counts.values[::-1]):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:,}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Registration Trends Over Years
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
yearly_counts = df.groupby('StichtagDatJahr')['AnzHunde'].sum()
ax2.plot(yearly_counts.index, yearly_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         color='#2E86AB', markersize=8)
ax2.fill_between(yearly_counts.index, yearly_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='#2E86AB')
ax2.set_xlabel('Year')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Dogs Registered')
ax2.set_title('Dog Registration Trends Over Years', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Distribution of Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_district = sns.color_palette("mako", len(district_counts))
bars3 = ax3.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors_district)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_ylabel('District')
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District (Kreis)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels
for bar, val in zip(bars3, district_counts.values):
    ax3.text(val + 20, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:,}', 
             va='center', fontsize=8)

# 4. Dog Age Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Filter out NaN values and get age distribution
age_dist = df.groupby('AlterVHundLang')['AnzHunde'].sum()
# Sort by the numeric age value
age_order = df[['AlterVHundLang', 'AlterVHundSort']].drop_duplicates().sort_values('AlterVHundSort')
age_order = age_order[age_order['AlterVHundLang'].isin(age_dist.index)]
age_dist_sorted = age_dist.reindex(age_order['AlterVHundLang'])

colors_age = sns.color_palette("YlOrRd", len(age_dist_sorted))
bars4 = ax4.bar(range(len(age_dist_sorted)), age_dist_sorted.values, color=colors_age)
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(age_dist_sorted)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(age_dist_sorted.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Dog Age Category')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax4.set_title('Dog Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Add overall title
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
